description:
Get Reactome pathway information with hierarchy.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table reactome — one record = one Reactome pathway or reaction.
Key: id.
Arguments: pathway_id accepts reactome pathway (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: `_vbt.total` counts all matches.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Reactome pathways of OT 25.09 (existence only).

pathway_id.description: Accepts reactome_pathway; resolved to one reactome_pathway (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
